+    # We mock the original request method to avoid actual network calls

+    # Since we already patched requests.Session.request in the module import,

+    mock_resp.status_code = 200
+    mock_resp.headers = {}
+    mock_resp.content = b""
+

+    captured_headers = {}
+    
+    def side_effect(method, url, **kwargs):
+        nonlocal captured_headers
+        captured_headers = kwargs.get("headers", {})
+        return mock_resp
+
+    # Temporarily replace the original to verify the wrapper's logic

+    original = linkwatch.http_patch._original_request
+    linkwatch.http_patch._original_request = side_effect
+
